Visiting Us?

Learn more about Alnwick Playhouse

Alnwick Playhouse is located just outside the old walls of Alnwick Town in the heart of Northumberland. We offer live theatre, music, cinema alongside our cafe, bar, library and visitor information.

Your Visit

Support Us

Help us to continue to inspire

Every day at Alnwick Playhouse we welcome hundreds of people through our doors. We can’t do this without your help. We receive just 7% public funding every year – leaving us a huge 93% of our running costs to be found from ticket income, food & drink sales and you! Finding Funding gets harder every year, so please help where you can.

Support Us

Get involved!

Join one of our community groups

Alnwick Playhouse hosts a wide range of community groups from Youth Theatre and Choir to Spanish Language and Dance. We’re proud to cater for all ages, check out our classes & workshops below!
